ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white dominates approximately 85% of the visible surface; low-intensity black pixels are concentrated along the trailing perimeter and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous central region; continuous black banding along the entire trailing edge; small black focal spots (less than 1% of total area) scattered on the right lobe and a singular dark bi-lobed cluster positioned on the central vertical axis below the notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 75 degrees; vertex is sharply defined.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the left trailing edge; significantly higher amplitude, irregular jagged peaks and a prominent notch on the right trailing edge distal to the midline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the leading edge transition; trailing edge follows a generally convex arc toward the tips, interrupted by serration peaks.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast white circular pixel clusters indicative of barnacle colonization at the extreme distal tips of both left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Sparse, thin dark linear pixel disruptions visible as diagonal marks on the proximal left lobe and horizontal streaks on the mid-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct irregular trauma/notch located on the right trailing edge approximately one-third of the distance from the fluke tip toward the median notch.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique dark 'butterfly' shaped pigmentation mark located directly ventral to the median notch vertex.
